activationDescription: Finish the essentials, then start with a proven task.
contextInspectorDescription: Privacy-safe provenance for the latest completed run and a bounded preview of the next turn.
contextInspectionFailed: Run context is unavailable. Try again.
contextMessageTruncated: This visible message is truncated in the inspector.
contextNoCheckpoints: No persisted lifecycle checkpoints are available.
contextNoRun: This chat does not have a persisted run to inspect yet.
contextNoTools: No persisted tool activity is available.
contextNoTransformations: No persisted context transformations were recorded.
contextNoVisibleMessages: No visible user or assistant messages are available.
contextResourceUnavailable: A selected resource is no longer available; its safe identifier is retained for provenance.
contextSourceSummary: {{available}} of {{total}} cited sources are currently available.
contextSourcesRevoked: {{count}} cited source(s) are revoked, deleted, or no longer accessible.
noNotesAvailable: No personal or workspace notes are available.
noReusableFiles: No reusable files are available. Upload one from the composer to add it to this library.
starterDecisionPrompt: Turn the context I provide into a concise decision memo with options, tradeoffs, risks, and a recommendation.
starterPlanPrompt: Create an execution plan with milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and measurable success criteria.
starterResearchPrompt: Research this topic, compare credible sources, call out disagreements, and finish with sourced recommendations.
starterSummarizePrompt: Summarize the document or text I attach into key points, decisions, open questions, and next actions.
composerKnowledgePickerHelp: Override which knowledge bases retrieval uses for the next message. Leave on model defaults unless you need a one-turn change.
loadEarlierMessagesDescription: Loads earlier messages before the current transcript and preserves your reading position.
windowedTranscriptModeDescription: Only nearby messages are rendered for performance. Press Control or Command plus F, or choose Show all loaded messages, for browser find and an uninterrupted assistive-technology reading order.
fullTranscriptModeDescription: All loaded messages are rendered in document order for browser find, selection, and assistive technology.
agenticRagHelp: Search again with rewritten or split queries when the first results are weak.
agenticRagForcedHelp: Your organization requires agentic retrieval for knowledge-backed chats.
chatSearchFailed: Chat search could not be completed.
reasoningUnavailable: The selected model does not advertise reasoning support. Choose the agent default or turn reasoning off before sending.
reasoningCostDisclosure: Higher reasoning levels can increase latency and token cost.
reasoningPolicyRejected: This reasoning request cannot run with the selected model or policy.
reasoningAdjustedGovernanceCap: Reduced to the effective organization or workspace maximum.
reasoningAdjustedDialectUnsupported: The provider protocol does not support this setting.
reasoningAdjustedModelUnsupported: The selected model or provider does not support this setting.
